item.title: EU Escalates Oil Sanctions With Broad Ban on Shipping Services
item.description: The European Union is preparing to take a much bigger swing at Russia’s oil trade, and this time Brussels is aiming less at optics and more at the plumbing that actually keeps barrels moving. item.title: Why Cutting Russia Out of India’s Oil Mix Won’t Be Easy

item.description: The tax on carbon Europe introduced at the beginning of the year may have some surprising knock-on effects. item.title: The U.S. LNG Boom Is Lowering Europe’s Energy Costs and Raising America’s
item.description: The United States has cemented its position as the world's leading exporter of Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG) over the past couple of years, thanks to surging natural gas demand in Europe and Asia.
